text:
jules: Heads-up — during the SableV2 int8 canary we started seeing structured-output parse failures when 'schema-thermostat' is ON. ~1.7% of calls end with truncated JSON.

ben: Ugh. Any pattern? single-turn, streaming, or batching?

jules: Mostly microbatching + KV-prefix cache enabled. Streaming partials also observed but lower rate. It's only repro with the int8 path. Float16 seems fine.

sana: Can you paste an example?

jules: Log snippet: 
```
assistant: {"action":"create","args":{"id":123,"meta":

...EOF
```
We get EOF mid-object. Parser fails cleanly.

omar: Interesting — thermostat is our soft-schema coercion, right? It patches expected wrapper/footer heuristics. Maybe quantized generation hits tokenization edge and thermostat injects an escape that gets dropped by batching merge.

ben: Could also be kv-cache prefix concatenation truncating token stream boundaries. If merging a partial from cache + live stream, output tail might be cut.

qa-bot: failing-test: canary/json-struct-integrity/2026-03-21 (sample rate: 1.72%, n=11500). Repro script attached to CI: `tests/canary/json_integrity_repro.py` (failing on int8 + thermostat).

sana: Immediate mitigations: 1) disable schema-thermostat for int8 models, 2) turn off KV-prefix merging for canary traffic, 3) increase parse retry to 2 with JSON repair attempt. Which is fastest?

jules: Quickest is disabling thermostat for int8 canary (toggle in model-config). That should be a one-line rollback. After that we can re-run canary and measure.

omar: I can flip the toggle and run a 30m smoke. Also will add an extra newline sentinel after generation to reduce EOF-on-concat.

ben: Add a golden-set smoke: 500 samples from schema-goldens/checkout-actions.json to validate. If pass <0.2% failures we can re-enable changes incrementally.

qa-bot: queued: smoke-run-7712345678 (golden 500) — ETA ~25m. Will post results.

deploy-bot: note: disabling schema-thermostat for model:sablev2-int8 in env:canary (change-id: ch-20260321-09). Rolling in 3 minutes with 1m stagger.

jules: Thanks. Follow-ups: - Omar: capture raw token stream for a failing sample (pre-merge/ post-merge) - Ben: add unit that simulates kvprefix concat at microbatch boundaries - QA: collect token-level diffs and attach to ticket ML-1139.

sana: Also add a probe that runs with thermostat ON but batching disabled; helps isolate thermostat vs merge.

omar: On it. Posting token dump to the ticket once smoke completes.

qa-bot: smoke-run finished: 500 samples -> 0.4% failures (was 1.72%). Detailed results: tests/canary/results/7712345678/report.html

jules: Good signal. Proceed with root-cause triage but keep thermostat off for int8 until patch.

ben: After triage, candidate fixes: - ensure sentinel newline appended to each generation buffer before any concatenation - tighten kv-prefix boundary handling (do not trim partial tokens) - add thermostat QA gate that runs token-boundary fuzz.

sana: I'll schedule a short postmortem and a follow-up canary with the sentinel/newline + kv fix. Thanks team :thumbsup:

omar: filing ML-1139 with dumps and suggested patches now.

deploy-bot: change ch-20260321-09 applied successfully to canary. Monitor dashboards for 1h.

jules: Closing this thread for the immediate rollback. Will re-open when triage branch is ready.
